verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is documented as a terminal-based AI coding agent. It has an interactive TUI, a headless `--prompt` CLI mode with stdin piping, local SQLite storage by default, and a `mastracode update` command for the locally installed package. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of running it locally, and explicit installation/system-requirements documentation in the evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: Mastra Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent built on Mastra's
Pass `--prompt` (or `-p`) to run a single task and exit
Connect to a remote database instead of the default local SQLite
Run `mastracode update` to install the latest version with the package manager that installed Mastra Code.
